units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 16a:3">R. Hash. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>תבואה שאירע בה ק׳ וכ׳</he> a crop to which an accident happened (an injury from natural causes) or a misfortune (through human agencies).
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 16a:3">Ib.</cite> <he>אדם … ק׳ וכ׳</he> a man whom a mishap befell or &c.
<cite ref="Yoma 88a:2">Yoma 88ᵃ</cite> <he>בעל ק׳</he> one to whom pollution happened; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="S02056"><he>קְרָיִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 22b:15">Ber. 22ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 82a:3">B. Kam. 82ᵃ</cite> (Ms. H. <cite ref="S01241"><he>קְרָאִין</he></cite>); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:3:3">Y. Meg. IV, 75ᵃ</cite> top; a. e.
